funnel.note: Defaults are mid-range for cold outbound to a well-defined ICP. Replace with your numbers.

deliverability.label: SPF record
deliverability.detail: One record per domain, under 10 DNS lookups, ends in -all.

deliverability.label: DKIM signing
deliverability.detail: 2048-bit keys, rotated, one selector per sending platform.

deliverability.label: DMARC policy
deliverability.detail: Start at p=none with rua reports, move to p=quarantine once alignment is clean.

deliverability.label: Secondary sending domains
deliverability.detail: Never send cold from the primary domain. Use lookalikes that redirect to the main site.

deliverability.label: Warm-up
deliverability.detail: New mailboxes ramp from 5 to 30 sends a day over 3 weeks before any campaign.

deliverability.label: Volume caps
deliverability.detail: 30 to 50 cold sends per mailbox per day. Volume comes from mailbox count, not per-box volume.

deliverability.label: Address validation
deliverability.detail: Bounce rate under 2 percent. Drop catch-all addresses unless verified.

deliverability.label: Monitoring
deliverability.detail: Daily inbox placement test and blacklist check. Pause a domain automatically on a failure.
